responsibility: Declares the shared ReadResults enumeration used throughout the gm2 ISO input/output libraries to report the outcome of reads. It standardizes state codes such as allRight, wrongFormat, endOfLine, and endOfInput so channel devices and higher-level text/numeric readers can communicate read status consistently.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the substantive part of IOConsts, defining the shared ReadResults enumeration used across the ISO I/O stack; the same-stem IOConsts.mod is only an empty implementation placeholder.
